name: Othniel
bio: Othniel was the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother. Caleb promised that whoever captured the city of Kiriath Sepher (Debir) would receive his daughter Achsah as his wife; Othniel took the city and married Achsah (Joshua 15:16-17). Othniel later became the first of Israel's judges in the book of Judges — the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he delivered Israel from the oppression of Cushan-Rishathaim, king of Mesopotamia, giving the land forty years of peace, a story told in full in Judges 3.
